_description: Baseline config v7: H1 (deployment floor) + H4 (momentum reweight) + H5 (shorter hold) permanently integrated. All values are current defaults. Copy and modify for hypothesis testing.
notes: v6 changes from v5: universe.score_weight_proximity 0.60->0.45, universe.score_weight_momentum 0.40->0.55 (H4).
v5 change from v4: entry.deployment_floor_n raised from 0 to 2 (H1).
run.run_id: output goes to backtest_logs/{run_id}/. Use unique name per hypothesis.
run.initial_equity: $50k matches real account baseline for SPY comparison.
run.max_api_calls: 2000 sufficient for full year (avg ~3 calls/day x 252 = ~756).
entry.deployment_floor_n: 2 = force at least 2 buy-stops on FULL regime days (H1).
exit.stop_pct: 0.04 = 4% initial hard stop below entry price.
exit.max_hold_days: 7 = standard swing hold cap (PEAD can hold up to pead_max_hold_days).
regime.vix_cash_threshold: 25.0 = above this -> CASH, no new entries.
regime.regime_full_score: 5 = score >= 5/5 gates = FULL deployment (all gates, matches live MarketRegimeFilter).
